tip.simpleovens.oven_upgrade: Axe or hammer, nugget in off hand: upgrade in place
simpleovens.guide.page.1.title: Simple Ovens
simpleovens.guide.page.1: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces that cook 2, 4 and 8 times as fast, and furnace minecarts of the same tiers.
simpleovens.guide.page.2.title: Faster Furnaces: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite
simpleovens.guide.page.2: Three upgraded tiers of the furnace, the smoker and the blast furnace. They use the recipes and menus of their Vanilla counterparts but cook 2, 4 and 8 times as fast;
simpleovens.guide.page.3.title: Faster Furnaces: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite
simpleovens.guide.page.3: Netherite and Enderite give double experience. The Reinforced tier is crafted, the Netherite and Enderite tiers are upgraded in the world.
simpleovens.guide.page.4.title: In-World Upgrade
simpleovens.guide.page.4: A placed Reinforced machine becomes the Netherite one with a Netherite Nugget in the off hand, a Netherite machine
simpleovens.guide.page.5.title: In-World Upgrade
simpleovens.guide.page.5: the Enderite one with an Enderite Nugget. On its own the axe strikes it; with SimpleBuilding only its sledgehammer does.
simpleovens.guide.page.6.title: Furnace Minecarts
simpleovens.guide.page.6: Reinforced, Netherite and Enderite furnace minecarts: one fuel item burns 2, 4 or 8 times as long as in Vanilla's furnace cart
simpleovens.guide.page.7.title: Furnace Minecarts
simpleovens.guide.page.7: (the speed of the furnace of the tier), and the cart runs at 5/8, 3/4 or all of a plain minecart's top speed.
simpleovens.guide.page.8.title: Long Cook Times in the Menu
simpleovens.guide.page.8: Furnace menus send their timers as shorts; cook times above 32767 ticks are divided before sending, so the arrow and the flame keep the right ratio.
simpleovens.guide.page.9.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simpleovens.guide.page.9: The furnaces, their block entities, the furnace carts, their 8 recipes and recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simpleovens.guide.page.10.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simpleovens.guide.page.10: Old worlds load them under simpleovens:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids.
simpleovens.guide.page.11.title: Settings
simpleovens.guide.page.11: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
quests.simpleovens.start.title: Welcome to Simple Ovens
quests.simpleovens.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleovens.start.welcome.title: A free guide
quests.simpleovens.start.welcome.descrip: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Ovens Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and charcoal.
